quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: When should you signal before passing another vehicle?

options.text: Early so other drivers know what you plan to do.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early so other drivers know what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers have time to know your plans.

questions.question: When can you carefully continue through an intersection with a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already inside the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already inside the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If the light turns yellow while you are already in the intersection, you should continue through carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a school zone is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever you can.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
Get to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and honk to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each time you pass, there is more risk of a collision. Drive with traffic flow at a safe speed and pass only when needed.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spot before changing lanes?

options.text: Look in the left side mirror.
Look in the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder toward where you want to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder toward where you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: What lights must you use when driving in rain?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in rain.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and stay farther from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a side road is ahead. Be aware that traffic may enter from that side road.

questions.question: Signs that require drivers to follow a specific instruction are called:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. Breaking these rules can result in a penalty.

questions.question: When you borrow an unfamiliar car from a friend, you should:

options.text: Not worry about it because all cars work the same way.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the car.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where and how all the car's controls work.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where and how all the car's controls work.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, spend a few minutes learning the location and operation of turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Have any problems fixed before you drive.

questions.question: What colors do warning signs use to alert drivers to upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black letters or symbols. In work zones, warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: If you are driving so slowly that traffic is backing up behind you, you should:

options.text: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
Prevent other cars from passing you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than traffic flow is dangerous. On a two-lane road, you must pull off and let other cars pass if you are driving slow enough to cause a backup. Only drive slower than the speed limit when conditions require it.

questions.question: When a driver behind you wants to pass, you should:

options.text: Slow down to give the other driver space to pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give the other driver space to pass safely.
questions.explanation: When a driver behind wants to pass, slow down to create enough space in front of your car. This makes it easier and faster for the other driver to complete the pass.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: If you become stranded in a snowstorm, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Leave the car and walk for help.
Lie down in the car and sleep.
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in the car where rescuers can find you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the car where rescuers can find you.
questions.explanation: If stranded in a snowstorm, stay in your car. You are more likely to be found in your vehicle. Walking around in a snowstorm is unsafe.

questions.question: Which of these substances can impair your driving and lead to a driving under the influence (DUII) arrest?

options.text: Inhalants such as glue or paint

questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving, including alcohol, illegal drugs, inhalants, and many legal medications (both prescription and over-the-counter).

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What do two solid yellow lines on the road mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed for drivers from both directions.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during daylight only.

questions.explanation: Yellow lines show traffic moving in opposite directions. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass, from either direction.

questions.question: You are driving uphill and approaching a heavy truck from behind. You should know:

options.text: The truck may be going slower than the speed limit.
You may not be able to safely pass the truck.
You may not be able to legally pass the truck.

questions.explanation: Large trucks often go slower than the speed limit, especially on hills. Be careful when approaching them. On a hill with limited visibility, passing is illegal.

questions.question: You can reduce the risk of hydroplaning by driving:
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Slow down to reduce the risk.

questions.question: When turning left, you have the right-of-way on which traffic signal?
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because few vehicles are coming.
By using the shoulder of the highway.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.explanation: Do not pass on a hill or in a curve because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never drive on the shoulder to pass. Do not cross a solid yellow line to pass.

questions.question: How can you avoid the risks of drunk driving crashes?

options.text: Decide before drinking that you will not drive.
Say "No thanks, I'm driving" if offered a drink.

questions.explanation: The best way to avoid drunk driving risks is to decide before you drink that you will not drive. Alcohol affects your judgment, making it harder to make safe choices later.

questions.question: At an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk, where should you stop?

options.text: You do not need to stop.
You must slow down to check if traffic is clear.
Stop where you can see 200 feet in either direction, even if you enter the roadway.
Stop where you can see approaching traffic before entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can see approaching traffic before entering the roadway.
questions.explanation: Stop at the closest point to the intersecting roadway where you can see traffic coming. Do not enter the roadway to get a better view.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn your radio down to listen for a train.
Only cross when a flagger tells you it is safe.

questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you know no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, follow their instructions.

questions.question: Where is it best to keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only on the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not drive too close to vehicles on your left or right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must follow what it says. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: How are crosswalks marked?

options.text: Always with vertical lines on the pavement.
Always with horizontal lines on the pavement.
With pavement markings or not marked at all.

questions.correctAnswerText: With pavement markings or not marked at all.
questions.explanation: Crosswalks exist whether they have markings or not. You must stop to let pedestrians cross at any crosswalk.

questions.question: What is distracted driving?

options.text: Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving is very dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Pay full attention to the road to avoid crashes.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Where should your car be after the turn?

options.text: In the center of the street.
In the lane with the least traffic.

questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street to a one-way street, turn into the left lane. This lane is closest to where you came from.

questions.question: What does an "End school zone" sign mean?

options.text: The speed limit is now 20 mph.
You are entering a slower speed zone.
More pedestrians may be on the road ahead.
The slower speed zone has ended.

questions.correctAnswerText: The slower speed zone has ended.
questions.explanation: Follow the school zone speed limit during the times shown. An "End school zone" sign shows where the slower speed zone stops.

questions.question: You find a defect in your vehicle that could affect safe driving. What should you do?

options.text: Fix it as soon as possible.
Fix it when you have money.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix it as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Fix any defect that affects safe driving right away. Do not drive the vehicle until the problem is fixed.
